name: ~Etsuraku Houshi~ Obscene Service
source:
The Kuranashis are a young couple who live in the lap of luxury and enjoy a comfortable wealthy lifestyle, when they suddenly have a visitor, unplanned and out of the blue.
They are informed that she is a younger half-sister by a different mother in relation to Takashi, the Kuranashi husband.
The bright, cheerful girl is invited to stay in the couple's home; however when doing so they fail to notice the dark side she has to her personality.
Sayaka prostitutes herself out for money and for pleasure, and she eventually compels Masumi to offer her own body up to men she does not know.
Sucked into a trap, she receives training, and experiences many strange excitements...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032540.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
仓科隆与真澄是一对年轻夫妻，生活富裕舒适，尽享奢华。某天，一名不速之客毫无预兆地登门造访。
两人得知，少女沙也香是隆同父异母的妹妹。
开朗活泼的她受邀住进夫妻家中，两人却没有察觉其性格中的阴暗面。
沙也香为了金钱与快感出卖肉体，最终更逼迫真澄向陌生男人献上身体。
真澄落入圈套，被迫接受调教，体验种种怪异刺激……

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032540.html]DLsite English[/url]]
